title: A new $SL_2$-action on the rank-two $βγ$-system
summary: We construct an explicit rational \(\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb C)\)-action on the underlying vector space of the rank-two \(βγ\)-system. The construction is motivated by Creutzig's branching decomposition with respect to \(L_{-1}(\mathfrak{sl}_2)\) and a rank-one Heisenberg vertex algebra. We realize the raising and lowering operators as residues of lattice-type fields, prove that they preserve the original \(βγ\)-system despite being defined on localizations, and establish their commutation relations and integrability.
